<h2>Run One sjSDM Tuning Work Item</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Fits, predicts, and scores one deterministic candidate/fold work item using
a previously prepared fold.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_tuning_work_item(
  data_work_item = NULL,
  list_prepared_folds = NULL,
  fit_function = NULL,
  predict_function = NULL,
  score_function = score_sjsdm_tuning_predictions,
  epsilon = 1e-06
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_work_item">data_work_item</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row work item from [build_sjsdm_tuning_branch_work_items()]. The optional
'tuning_applicable = FALSE' sentinel returns without fitting.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_prepared_folds">list_prepared_folds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Prepared fold list from [prepare_sjsdm_tuning_folds()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fit_function">fit_function</code>, <code id="predict_function">predict_function</code>, <code id="score_function">score_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable functions documented by [run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="epsilon">epsilon</code></td>
<td>
<p>Probability clipping tolerance passed to the score function.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing 'work_item_id', one-row 'data_tuning', and one compact
prediction-cache record. Fitted model objects are omitted.
</p>

</main>
